root_causes.description: The checkout pod (checkout-5df89485f4-5ptgq) is stuck NotReady because its container repeatedly fails to start: the sandbox image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest cannot be pulled (ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff), and the checkout container is placed into a restart back-off, so the pod never becomes Ready and serves no traffic.

evidence.expected_baseline: 0 ImagePullBackOff events; pod Ready shortly after scheduling

evidence.query_or_id: BackOff: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-5df89485f4-5ptgq_otel-demo(15dda906-0f46-4cc7-b64d-16c1f5d (count=1)
Failed: Failed to pull image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = failed to pull a (count=1)

evidence.observed_value: error_rate mean=0.000 max=0.000 across window (pod serving no requests)
evidence.expected_baseline: checkout serves traffic with non-zero request rate when Ready

evidence.observed_value: cpu_usage mean=0.001 p99=0.002 (near zero) across window
evidence.expected_baseline: steady active CPU while checkout handles orders

root_causes.description: Alternate framing of the same signature: the checkout pod cannot satisfy its sandbox image dependency, so the container cannot start and the pod stays NotReady; this is an image/sandbox dependency unavailability rather than a downstream business-service failure.

evidence.query_or_id: Failed: Failed to pull image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = failed to pull a (count=2)
evidence.observed_value: second DeadlineExceeded pull failure for sandbox image on checkout pod

evidence.expected_baseline: no restart increase in steady state

root_causes.description: product-catalog-5bb7676754-hcfpv was (re)scheduled in the same window; a normal scheduling event with no error/latency/restart anomaly observed, included as a lower-probability co-occurring pod lifecycle change.

evidence.expected_baseline: pod remains scheduled/Ready without re-assignment in steady state

remediation_steps: Inspect the checkout Deployment (checkout-5df89485f4) to determine why the sandbox image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails to pull (registry reachability, imagePullSecrets, rate limiting).
Restore the image pull path or pre-seed/mirror the pause image on otel-sre-copilot-control-plane and update the sandbox image reference if gcr.io is unreachable.
Delete the stuck pod checkout-5df89485f4-5ptgq so it is recreated once the image is resolvable, and confirm the pod reaches Ready.
Add/keep an alert on ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff and KubePodNotReady for otel-demo pods to catch this class of failure earlier.
